summary_ja: ファースト・トゥ・デフォルト型クレジット・デリバティブを信用リスク削減手法として用いない。
summary_en: First-to-default credit derivatives bought are not recognized as credit risk mitigation.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall not use first-to-default credit derivatives as a credit risk mitigation technique.
